Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high-fidelity UI concept image for Remaining Margin Float, a small Windows WPF desktop quota-monitoring floating widget for Codex, Kimi Code and DeepSeek. This is a product UI design exploration, NOT a website, NOT a phone app. All UI labels in simplified Chinese except provider names and Token. Show exactly ONE flat front-facing window, crisp realistic typography, feasible WPF shapes, no perspective, no computer/phone/device, no marketing hero, no extra panels. Canvas square 1024x1024. Put only a tiny concept identifier at top-left of canvas and tiny '演示数据' at bottom-left of canvas. All data are fictional examples for comparison. Percentages and Chinese must render accurately. Consistent information across all directions. No photographic content inside this utility.
COMPACT LAYOUT. Exactly one tiny 80x80 logical-pixel SQUARE floating widget enlarged to approximately 400x400 image pixels at canvas center for inspection. Preserve realistic tiny-widget information density: ONLY provider label 'Codex' at top, dominant '68%' centered with percent sign smaller, label '5 小时余量' below, and ONE restrained progress indicator. No other account information, no buttons, no weekly quota, no large app title. Generous canvas around widget but tight efficient spacing inside it. All content fits true 80x80 logical size, no tiny illegible data.
Direction A, QUIET WINDOWS NATIVE. Cool pearl background canvas #e8edf2, opaque porcelain window #fafbfc, near-black text #202831, cobalt accent #416fd6 used only for quota and selection, neutral cool gray tracks. Segoe UI Variable-like sans with generous legible apertures and tabular numerals, precise 8px spacing grid, 14 logical-pixel corner radius, fine cool-gray 1px border, subtle elevation, no glass refraction. Detail layout hierarchy: very light provider toolbar; large left-aligned 68% hero with smaller label and reset to right below toolbar; thin FULL-WIDTH horizontal main progress; weekly line below; softly grouped stats; two side-by-side thin blue line charts. Calm, light, native, disciplined. Compact uses a hairline cobalt horizontal progress track along bottom, small provider left-aligned, large centered dark numeral.
Tiny canvas identifier 'A / 浅色原生 / 紧凑布局'.

Top-left small canvas annotation 'B / 深色仪表 / 紧凑布局'. Bottom-left small annotation '演示数据'. This is a standalone high-fidelity app mockup image, no device, no website, no perspective.
